text: News & Events Speakers Joshua Lant Joshua Lant University of Manchester Organisation University of Manchester LinkedIn Biography Joshua Lant is a Research Associate in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Manchester. He has been in the Advanced Processor Technologies group since 2016, being awarded his Ph.D in 2019 for work on FPGA interconnects in HPC architectures. His primary research interests are in Linux networking and PCIe, FPGA interconnects and microarchitecture, and binary modification tools.
